searchText: I missed 4 attestations in a row (on purpose) I was only fined 3*the base reward each time I missed. Where is the special fine I was supposed to get? What do you mean by "special fine"? Reading the spec I thought there was an extra special fine for being inactive for 4 epochs Hence the constant Min Epochs To Inactivity Penalty of 4 That is for the entire chain. If it fails to reach finality after 4 epochs it starts to penalise every validator Oh Thanks
